spans.s: Raurava, m. (= Pali Roruva), n. of a hot hell, very common: often followed by Mahāraurava, from which in Mv 〔i.5.13〕. it seems to be specially distinguished as ekānta-raurava (mahā-r˚ occurs in 14); the two referred to as dvau ca rauravau Mv 〔i.9.8〕 = 〔iii.454.7〕 (vs); foll. by mahā-r˚, Mvy 〔4923〕; Dharmas 〔121〕; Divy 〔67.22〕; 〔138.6〕; 〔366.28〕; Av 〔i.4.8〕, etc.; without mahā-r˚, Mv 〔iii.274.11〕; Kv 〔18.12〕, et alibi.
